<function name="SetGlobal2Angle" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Defines an angle to be automatically networked to clients

<note>Running this function clientside will only set it clientside for the client it is called on!</note>
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="index" type="any">Index to identify the global angle with</arg>
		<arg name="angle" type="Angle">Angle to be networked</arg>
	</args>
</function>
